cd /app/work && cat > prof5.py <<'PYEOF'
import time, importlib.util, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import checker
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("planner", "/app/submission/planner.py")
planner = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(planner)
path = sys.argv[1]
for i,line in enumerate(open(path)):
    print("line",i,flush=True)
    line=line.strip()
    if not line: continue
    t0=time.perf_counter()
    try: req = planner.validate(planner.parse_request(line))
    except planner.Invalid: continue
    prob = planner.build_problem(req); prob["epoch"]=req["epoch"]
    print("   built %.2f"%(time.perf_counter()-t0),flush=True)
    res = planner._safe_linprog(prob["c"],prob["A_ub"],prob["b_ub"],prob["A_eq"],prob["b_eq"],(0.0,None),"highs",{"presolve":True})
    print("   solved status",res.status,"%.2f"%(time.perf_counter()-t0),flush=True)
    if res is not None and res.status==0:
        primal=planner.make_primal(prob,res)
        d=planner.dual_by_lp(prob)
        print("   dualbylp %.2f"%(time.perf_counter()-t0),flush=True)
        cand=planner.optimal_response(prob,primal,d)
        errs=checker.check(line,cand["response"])
        print("   checked %.2f errs=%s"%(time.perf_counter()-t0,errs),flush=True)
    elif res is not None and res.status==2:
        cert=planner.witness_phase_one(prob)
        print("   phase1 %.2f"%(time.perf_counter()-t0),flush=True)
        errs=checker.check(line,planner.infeasible_response(req,cert)) if cert else ["phase1 none"]
        print("   checked %.2f errs=%s"%(time.perf_counter()-t0,errs),flush=True)
PYEOF
head -6 req_fallback_sub.jsonl > req_head6.jsonl && timeout 60 python -u prof5.py req_head6.jsonl 2>&1 | tail -30; echo "rc=$?"
